reason: In app/serializers/user_serializer.rb:43,105-111,137-155, `:website_name` is serialized as an attribute but omitted from `untrusted_attributes` (unlike `:website`), and neither `website_name` nor `include_website_name` checks `scope.restrict_user_fields?(object)`. As a result, TL0 users' website host/path is exposed to anonymous viewers in both the API payload and user profile template, whereas previously it was derived client-side from the restricted `model.website`.
